description: Concave versus convex electrostatics of amphiphysin (control, validated on its known membrane-binding lysines), ACAP1 and ACAP3 BAR dimers
code:
import numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T',
 'TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
CHG={('LYS','NZ'):1.0,('ARG','CZ'):1.0,('ASP','CG'):-1.0,('GLU','CD'):-1.0,('HIS','NE2'):0.1}
def read_full(fn,chain=None,lo=None,hi=None):
    at=[]
    for l in open(fn):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        c=l[21]; num=int(l[22:26])
        if chain and c!=chain: continue
        if lo is not None and not(lo<=num<=hi): continue
        at.append((rn,l[12:16].strip(),c,num,np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
    return at
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc));D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def biomt_dimer(fn,chain):
    cur={}
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith("REMARK 350   BIOMT"):
            cur.setdefault(int(l[18]),[]).append([float(x) for x in l[24:].split()])
    out=[]; mono=read_full(fn,chain=chain)
    for i in range(len(cur[1])):
        M=np.array([cur[1][i][:3],cur[2][i][:3],cur[3][i][:3]])
        T=np.array([cur[1][i][3],cur[2][i][3],cur[3][i][3]])
        for rn,nm,c,num,x in mono: out.append((rn,nm,"AB"[i],num,M@x+T))
    return out
amph=biomt_dimer("1URU.pdb","A")
acap1=read_full("4NSW.pdb",chain="A",lo=1,hi=230)+read_full("4NSW.pdb",chain="B",lo=1,hi=230)
Z=np.load("bar_models.npz"); a3m=Z['acap3_ca']
a3_src=read_full("AF_ACAP3.pdb",chain="A",lo=1,hi=230)
srcCA=np.array([x for rn,nm,c,num,x in a3_src if nm=="CA"]); n=len(srcCA)
acap3=[]
for i,cid in enumerate(("A","B")):
    R,t=kabsch(srcCA,a3m[i*n:(i+1)*n])
    for rn,nm,c,num,x in a3_src: acap3.append((rn,nm,cid,num,R@x+t))

def frame(atoms):
    CA=np.array([a[4] for a in atoms if a[1]=="CA"])
    C=CA.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(CA-C,full_matrices=False); pc=(CA-C)@Vt.T
    k=sorted([(abs(np.polyfit(pc[:,0],pc[:,j],2)[0]),j) for j in (1,2)])[-1][1]
    co=np.polyfit(pc[:,0],pc[:,k],2)
    return C,Vt,pc,k,co

def analyse(atoms,label,check=None):
    C,Vt,pc,k,co=frame(atoms); a=co[0]
    concave_sign=np.sign(a)                 # parabola opens toward the concave (inner) side
    j3=({1,2}-{k}).pop()
    cas=[(rn,num,ch) for rn,nm,ch,num,x in atoms if nm=="CA"]
    off=concave_sign*(pc[:,k]-np.polyval(co,pc[:,0]))
    # validation: where do the named control residues sit?
    if check:
        for num in check:
            idx=[i for i,(rn,nu,ch) in enumerate(cas) if nu==num]
            if idx: print(f"      control residue {cas[idx[0]][0]}{num}: offset {off[idx[0]]:+.1f} A "
                          f"({'CONCAVE' if off[idx[0]]>0 else 'convex'})")
    X=np.array([x for rn,nm,ch,num,x in atoms])
    Qp=np.array([CHG[(rn,nm)] for rn,nm,ch,num,x in atoms if (rn,nm) in CHG])
    Qx=np.array([x for rn,nm,ch,num,x in atoms if (rn,nm) in CHG])
    xs=np.linspace(np.percentile(pc[:,0],5),np.percentile(pc[:,0],95),40)
    zs=np.linspace(np.percentile(pc[:,j3],15),np.percentile(pc[:,j3],85),9)
    out={}
    for side,sgn in (("concave",concave_sign),("convex",-concave_sign)):
        pts=[]
        for xv in xs:
            yl=np.polyval(co,xv); near=np.abs(pc[:,0]-xv)<6
            if near.sum()<3: continue
            e=pc[near,k]-yl; lim=e.max() if sgn>0 else e.min()
            for zv in zs:
                p=np.zeros(3); p[0]=xv; p[k]=yl+lim+sgn*6.0; p[j3]=zv
                pts.append(C+Vt.T@p)
        pts=np.array(pts)
        pts=pts[np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)>4.0]
        D=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-Qx[None,:,:],axis=2)
        phi=(332.0/78.0)*np.sum(Qp[None,:]*np.exp(-D/8.0)/D,axis=1)
        out[side]=float(np.mean(phi))
    print(f"   {label:<36} concave {out['concave']:+.3f}  convex {out['convex']:+.3f}  "
          f"Delta {out['concave']-out['convex']:+.3f} kcal/mol/e")
    return out

print("Validation of the concave assignment using amphiphysin membrane-binding residues (Peter et al.):")
r_am=analyse(amph,"Amphiphysin BAR (1URU) CONTROL",check=[132,133,134,137,140])
print()
r_a1=analyse(acap1,"ACAP1 BAR (4NSW crystal)")
r_a3=analyse(acap3,"ACAP3 BAR (AlphaFold on 4NSW)")
json.dump({"amphiphysin":r_am,"ACAP1":r_a1,"ACAP3":r_a3},open("bar_electrostatics_final.json","w"),indent=1)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2,4.4))
names=["Amphiphysin BAR\n(1URU, control)","ACAP1 BAR\n(4NSW crystal)","ACAP3 BAR\n(AlphaFold on 4NSW)"]
conc=[r_am['concave'],r_a1['concave'],r_a3['concave']]
conv=[r_am['convex'],r_a1['convex'],r_a3['convex']]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,conc,w,label="concave (membrane-facing)",color="#2166ac")
ax.bar(x+w/2,conv,w,label="convex (opposite)",color="#aaaaaa")
ax.axhline(0,color='k',lw=0.8); ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("mean screened-Coulomb potential\n6 A above the surface (kcal/mol/e)")
ax.set_title("BAR concave-face electrostatics, probe grid 6 A above the surface")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
